title: Computational workflow for discovering small molecular binders for shallow binding sites by integrating molecular dynamics simulation, pharmacophore modeling, and machine learning: STAT3 as case study.
authors: Jaradat, Nour Jamal; Hatmal, Mamon; Alqudah, Dana; Taha, Mutasem Omar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟、药效团建模和机器学习发现STAT3转录因子SH2结构域的小分子抑制剂，虽聚焦蛋白-配体而非TF-DNA互作，但MD+ML方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测与界面建模。
abstract: STAT3 belongs to a family of seven transcription factors. It plays an important role in activating the transcription of various genes involved in a variety of cellular processes. High levels of STAT3 are detected in several types of cancer. Hence, STAT3 inhibition is considered a promising therapeutic anti-cancer strategy. However, since STAT3 inhibitors bind to the shallow SH2 domain of the protein, it is expected that hydration water molecules play significant role in ligand-binding complicating the discovery of potent binders. To remedy this issue, we herein propose to extract pharmacophores from molecular dynamics (MD) frames of a potent co-crystallized ligand complexed within STAT3 SH2 domain. Subsequently, we employ genetic function algorithm coupled with machine learning (GFA-ML) to explore the optimal combination of MD-derived pharmacophores that can account for the variations in bioactivity among a list of inhibitors. To enhance the dataset, the training and testing lists were augmented nearly a 100-fold by considering multiple conformers of the ligands. A single significant pharmacophore emerged after 188 ns of MD simulation to represent STAT3-ligand binding. Screening the National Cancer Institute (NCI) database with this model identified one low micromolar inhibitor most likely binds to the SH2 domain of STAT3 and inhibits this pathway.
abstract_zh: STAT3属于一个由七种转录因子组成的家族。它在激活多种参与各种细胞过程的基因转录中发挥重要作用。在多种类型的癌症中检测到高水平的STAT3。因此，STAT3抑制被认为是一种有前景的抗癌治疗策略。然而，由于STAT3抑制剂与该蛋白的浅SH2结构域结合，预计水合水分子在配体结合中发挥重要作用，这使强效结合剂的发现复杂化。为解决此问题，我们在此提出从STAT3 SH2结构域内复合的强效共结晶配体的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 帧中提取药效团。随后，我们采用遗传函数算法结合机器学习 (GFA-ML) 来探索MD衍生药效团的最优组合，这些药效团能够解释抑制剂列表中生物活性的变异。为增强数据集，通过考虑配体的多种构象，训练和测试列表被扩充了近100倍。在188 ns的MD模拟后，出现了一个单一显著的药效团，代表STAT3-配体结合。使用此模型筛选国家癌症研究所 (National Cancer Institute) 数据库，识别出一个低微摩尔抑制剂，最可能结合STAT3的SH2结构域并抑制此通路。
